en.name: Marcellus I
en.summary: A pope who took a firm stance on readmitting Christians who had lapsed during the Diocletianic persecution, provoking violent unrest that led to his exile.
en.body: Marcellus I became pope after a lengthy vacancy following Marcellinus's death, during which the persecution had continued and the Roman church had been left without a settled leader. His insistence on a structured, penitential path back to communion for Christians who had lapsed under persecution — rather than either automatic exclusion or automatic readmission — provoked such severe unrest, including riots, that the emperor Maxentius exiled him from Rome, where he died shortly afterward.
